method: Independent raw STL triangle-coordinate comparison and oriented-solid queries; no mesh repair.

central_lip_core_preservation.method: Independent scipy bilinear sampling of original v15 lip_dy at raw mesh coordinates in r<=0.7 central lip ellipse; fairing must add zero. Resampled-grid difference is diagnostic only and is not used as the lip prescription.

mouth_wall_y_samples.method: Front-to-back rays; first inward-facing entry followed by outward-facing exit. This is Y-projected thickness, not a global perpendicular minimum.
mouth_wall_y_samples.scope_note: Broader fairing reaches front-wall inner surfaces inside the Y fade. Some sampled regions thicken; these increases are reported separately, not misclassified as thinning. Actual eye/neck/cap clearance is checked below.

seam_plane_precision_contact.note: Only a fully seated cap can use this plane-local classification; raw overlap volume is retained.

limitations: No physical print, resin shrinkage or body fitting has been tested.
Y-projected wall samples do not prove global minimum thickness or structural strength.
Manifold solid acceptance is not an exhaustive independent all-triangle self-intersection sweep.
Cap exits are discrete straight-line samples; sphere checks test endpoint clearances only.
Artistic mouth appearance requires inspection of same-camera renders.
